notes.title: New Add [Epic] Fish and Merge Content Fix
notes.content:
[b]Added [Epic] grade Fish! And improved Merge Content convenience!🐟✨[/b]


Added a new Epic grade.

Epic grade fish can be found in Merge content.

The probability of finding them in Merge content is approximately 0.989%.

Added [Epic] Apple Fish : 0.989% (Only Merge)


have also improved the inconvenience of not being able to continuously use existing Merge content. If you have enough fish in your inventory, there is no problem in continuously using Merge content.

will proceed if necessary for any bugs that occur in the future.

Thank you for your interest and play!

notes.title: New update! Added Fish Exchange content!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110093/0eafc44ec9be54d3125074fc63da77654052df5e.png[/img]

[b]This content allows you to exchange fish! 🐟✨[/b]

Added Exchange system:
You can exchange certain grades of fish for common fish!
Exchange them for common fish and catch rarer fish through Merge content!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45110093/d531d645a602c41c71085c7ad0001cb3b788645e.png[/img]

A new button has been created now.
Click on it, select the fish, and press the Exchange button to easily exchange them for a few regular fish.

When you exchange a [b]Green Common[/b] grade fish or a [b]Rare[/b] grade fish,
you can get a few common fish with the following probability.

Below are the fish exchange probabilities for each grade.

[Green Common]
Quantity: 1 regular Fish (25%) 
Quantity: 2 regular Fish (50%) 
Quantity: 3 regular Fish (25%) 

[Rare]
Quantity: 5 regular Fish (50%) 
Quantity: 6 regular Fish (30%) 
Quantity: 7 regular Fish (15%) 
Quantity: 8 regular Fish (5%)

notes.title: About future development direction
notes.content:
Clicker games are still very competitive, so I wanted to develop another game to avoid this competition.

However, I thought that facing this reckless competition would be a very valuable experience for me. Above all, I was very curious about how I would solve it myself.
In order to participate in the competition, I am constantly improving and developing to provide economic value to fish.

I would like to talk about the future development direction below.

[h1]1.Fish Item[/h1]
In order to preserve the value of fish items, we recently updated the usage of the fish. In the future, we are considering ways to preserve the value of green common and blue rare.

Of course, it will have a higher value than the general "Fish".


[h1]2.About various fish[/h1]
First of all, the types of fish are not as diverse as you might think.
In order to preserve the economic value of the types of fish, we will not suddenly increase the number of fish, and we plan to gradually increase the types of fish while preserving the value.


[h1]3.Feed System[/h1]
Currently, fish are given out every time you feed the fish every 3 hours. If you don't feed the fish, they will be very hungry.

Then you will not be able to get fish once every 3 hours.
However, a feature that is currently under consideration is to automatically feed fish every 3 hours. However, there may be cases where you continuously waste resources.


This is not a game that I took lightly.
It will be a different genre of game, not a simple clicker game.
Thank you.

O.o/ Good Luck!
